_about: House illustration library for event listings. Every published event must carry a hero image (scripts/assert-event-heroes.mjs). scripts/assign-event-heroes.mjs picks, in order: the event's own recorded hero, the listed venue's own verified photograph, then the first motif below whose pattern matches the event title (then summary), then the category default. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions tried in list order, so put specific subjects before general ones. To add a motif: generate it in the Coastal Punch style (docs/COASTAL-PUNCH-ILLUSTRATIONS.md), save a 1536x1024 WebP under next/public/images/generated/events/, then add an entry here.
